title: Hydration implementation
preamble:
# Hydration implementation

The reference-runtime contract for fact hydration. [LHYD] defines hydration as a language and author surface; this document
defines how a conforming runtime and its adapters implement it — the compiler's
`corr` check, the adapter's assertion protocol, the engine's budget and
retraction mechanisms, and the integrator API that drives them.

In detail: the declared `corr`
slot on a hydration target, the adapter assertion protocol, the engine-side budget /
supersede / series-skip mechanisms, the auto-registered builtin schemas, and the
integrator C API.

Prefix `RHIM`.

Parents:
- [LHYD] — the language-side hydration contract this document implements.
- [NCBK.9] — the integration callback surface hydration rides on.
- [RLOW.8.4] — series lowering, which the series-skip rule (RHIM.5.3) mirrors.
